title: Avalon
summary: Avalon is mystical island that is very prominent in Celtic lore and mythology, and the resting place of the powerful Casterwill weapon, the Willblade.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The [[Willblade]] was sealed in a stone here in an old castle ruin following a great war between the [[Casterwill family]] and [[the Betrayer]].  {{source|Knight of the Willblade}}

Following a quatrain left by [[Nostradamus]], the Huntik team discovered the key to finding the island was by following the Dragon's Breath, created by lighting the lamps on the Dragon's Cliffs. After arriving on Avalon, the team fought with [[Wilder]] and his men until the Willblade was finally recovered by [[Lok Lambert]], the champion of the [[Casterwill family]]. {{source|Knight of the Willblade}}

full_text:
Avalon is mystical island that is very prominent in Celtic lore and mythology, and the resting place of the powerful Casterwill weapon, the Willblade.

History

The Willblade was sealed in a stone here in an old castle ruin following a great war between the Casterwill family and the Betrayer. [Knight of the Willblade]

Following a quatrain left by Nostradamus, the Huntik team discovered the key to finding the island was by following the Dragon's Breath, created by lighting the lamps on the Dragon's Cliffs. After arriving on Avalon, the team fought with Wilder and his men until the Willblade was finally recovered by Lok Lambert, the champion of the Casterwill family. [Knight of the Willblade]

Trivia

• Its name is derived from the Gaelic name Avalonia which means "Island of Apples" and is also a key location for a number of tales in Arthurian lore.
